programme.title: Where Wild Men Are S12, Ep 3
Evolution S1, Ep 2
programme.desc: Bergabunglah dengan Chris Packham dalam petualangan epik selama empat miliar tahun menembus waktu untuk mengungkap bagaimana kehidupan di bumi berevolusi. Misinya: menjawab lima pertanyaan tentang lima hewan ikonik yang diciptakan oleh kekuatan alam yang tak terbendung.

programme.title: Uncharted Amazon S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: Jauh di dalam hutan Peru, seekor anteater sutra (silky anteater) berjuang untuk tetap terjaga, sementara seekor burung kolibri betina berusaha keras membesarkan anaknya. Selama jutaan tahun evolusi, mereka telah mengembangkan hubungan-hubungan yang unik dan strategi-strategi tak terduga untuk mengatasi perubahan kondisi lingkungan yang terus berlangsung. Namun, dengan segala kecerdikan yang mereka miliki, mereka tidak pernah siap menghadapi kedatangan spesies baru yang muncul di habitat mereka.

programme.desc: Seorang pencinta wanita kaya menulis buku harian tentang petualangan asmaranya, tetapi semua wanita yang pernah diselingkuhinya telah dibunuh.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Beberapa tahun sebelum film Ghostbusters sukses di Hollywood, Wong Jing menulis film komedi supranatural yang dibintangi oleh Alexander Fu dan disutradarai oleh Lau Ka Wing ini.

programme.title: To Kill A Mastermind
programme.desc: Sebuah sindikat kejahatan nan kejam, klan Qi Sha, yang dikendalikan oleh tujuh ketua, meneror Tiongkok. Pengadilan Kekaisaran memerintahkan Menteri Yang untuk menghancurkan mereka dengan mengirimkan mata-mata ke sana.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: Seorang mata-mata Tiongkok yang telah pensiun selama sepuluh tahun dan mencari nafkah sebagai tukang daging dikirim ke Hong Kong untuk menemukan tengkorak Tyrannosaurus rex yang dicuri.

programme.title: The Stormriders (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang panglima perang jahat menerima 2 murid (Angin & Awan) dalam upaya untuk menjadi tak terkalahkan agar dia dapat menguasai dunia.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: Sebuah kartel narkoba menduduki wilayah Dong Zhou. Mei Jing dari Unit Komando Wanita Thunderbolt memimpin timnya untuk menyerang markas mereka. Namun, Mei dan timnya disergap dan identitas ayah Mei terungkap.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tiba di kota untuk bekerja dengan teman mendiang sang ayah. Ketika toko pewarna mereka dibakar oleh seorang pemimpin geng setempat, ia memutuskan untuk melawan demi melindungi dan menyelamatkan toko.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tiba di kota untuk bekerja dengan teman mendiang sang ayah. Ketika toko pewarna mereka dibakar oleh seorang pemimpin geng setempat, ia memutuskan untuk melawan demi melindungi dan menyelamatkan toko.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: Anita Yuan Yung-yi berperan sebagai seorang anak perempuan yang tidak sengaja menemukan sebuah mutiara dengan jin di dalamnya. Michael Wong berperan sebagai jin yang mengabulkan tiga permintaannya.

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveller
programme.desc: Seorang pengawal kekaisaran dan tiga sahabat masa kecilnya yang berkhianat serta ditugaskan untuk memburunya secara tidak sengaja terkubur dan membeku dalam waktu. Setelah 400 tahun berlalu, mereka mencair dan kembali melanjutkan pertarungan yang belum terselesaikan.

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: Saat belajar di Jepang, Chen Zhen menemukan beberapa pelajar asal Tiongkok menghilang dan tanpa sengaja mengungkap sejumlah konspirasi kelompok Naga Hitam.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Son Donglu, seorang detektif yang baru dipromosikan, bekerja sama dengan Guo Zhui, penembak tercepat di Tiancheng, dan Xiaowu, seorang polisi pemula, untuk menyelidiki kematian misterius di sebuah pabrik peluru.

programme.title: Furious Attack (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang mantan tentara pasukan khusus menyusup ke Myanmar utara untuk menyelamatkan putrinya yang hilang, melawan geng penipu dan pedagang organ dalam pertarungan terakhir dengan bos kriminal tersebut.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: Seorang pengusaha serakah dari Hong Kong menyewa seorang pemburu muda untuk menangkap gorila raksasa yang konon hidup jauh di dalam hutan India. Pemburu itu menemukan kera tersebut, dan hidup bersamanya ia menemukan seorang wanita liar yang telah berteman dengan makhluk itu.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: Ketika Qing Cheng masih remaja, ia diserang oleh monster mutan yang tidak dikenal dan kehilangan keluarga serta ingatannya. Ia dianggap oleh penduduk desa sebagai orang yang tidak menyenangkan yang akan membawa bencana.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, putra dari pengusaha yang culun, mendapat kekecewaan usai mencari jodoh di Hawaii bersama temannya. Kemudian, secara tak sengaja mereka terjebak dalam sebuah pertukaran identitas yang kacau.

programme.title: Flying Swords Of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Berlatar tiga tahun setelah Dragon Inn, pemilik penginapan Jade telah menghilang dan sebuah penginapan baru telah bangkit dari reruntuhan - penginapan yang dikelola oleh para perampok yang menyamar sebagai warga negara yang taat hukum, yang berharap untuk menggali kota hilang yang legendaris yang terkubur di gurun.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta menemukan bahwa pasokan air di desanya telah terkontaminasi oleh kelelawar, dan saat sedang menggali sumur untuk mencari sumber air baru, ia tanpa sengaja menemukan mayat seorang pendeta Barat yang jahat.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs dan Octopus menerima pekerjaan dari pemilik kontrakan mereka: menculik seorang bayi. Tak lama kemudian, bayi itu membangkitkan perasaan kebapakan yang kuat dalam diri kedua penjahat tersebut, yang menyebabkan komplikasi ketika mereka harus menyerahkan bayi itu kepada kakeknya yang mungkin seorang bos geng gila.

programme.title: Michael Owen: My Breakthrough Years : Rewind
programme.desc: Michael Owen burst onto the scene for Liverpool at just seventeen years of age, and in two consecutive seasons the teenage sensation won the Premier League Golden Boot. Owen recalls those campaigns for the Reds, reliving the key moments that helped him develop into one of the greatest players of his generation.

programme.title: 2017/2018 (Gb: Salah) : Goals Of The Season
programme.desc: We take a look back at some of the most spectacular and important goals from previous Premier League seasons.

programme.title: (Subbed) Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: (Subbed) Roberto Mancini : PL Stories
programme.desc: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli. Mancini's interview is brutally honest, highlighting the defining moments and extraordinary career of one of football's most compelling characters.

programme.title: Kai Havertz : The Big Interview
programme.desc: As a young boy cheering from the terraces of his hometown club, Alemannia Aachen, Kai Havertz fell in love with a striker by the name of Erik Meijer. In this Extended version of the first Masterclass of the new season, Havertz' footballing icon surprises him at training, before the two share tricks of the trade on the art of forward play, recreating some of the Arsenal striker's best goals.

programme.title: Patrick Vieira : The Big Interview
programme.desc: From street football in Senegal to becoming Arsenal captain, Patrick Vieira reflects on the journey that shaped one of the league's most iconic figures, as he tells Steve Bower about the proudest chapter of his career: the 2003-04 Invincibles season.

programme.title: Peter & Kasper Schmeichel : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Sharing 6 Premier League trophies between them, Peter and Kasper Schmeichel can be classed individually amongst the best goalkeepers of the Premier League era. This week, the Big Interview takes the rare opportunity of having father and son together. The pair discuss their fascinating dynamic, a relationship that developed from Kasper's formative years growing up around a father who won 5 Premier League titles in a dominant Manchester United side. The pair then share incredible insight around the evolution of the art of goalkeeping, spanning their own careers to the present day.

programme.title: Mw10 : Netbusters
programme.desc: A fast-paced music and commentary driven ISO angle highlights show featuring every game and every goal from each match round.

programme.title: Theo Walcott: My Premier League Years : Rewind

Seiring waktu, mereka belajar bahwa empati, komunikasi, dan penerimaan menjadi kunci untuk menyembuhkan luka masa lalu dan melangkah menuju masa depan. Film drama ini menyajikan kisah yang hangat dan reflektif tentang perubahan, rekonsiliasi, serta kuatnya ikatan keluarga.

Di balik rutinitas mereka, masing-masing menyimpan masalah pribadi, rasa kesepian, dan tekanan hidup yang semakin memuncak. Ketika sebuah aksi kekerasan mengguncang suasana, hidup mereka berubah selamanya. Film ini mengangkat tema keterasingan, pencarian makna hidup, dan dampak dari keputusan yang diambil dalam kondisi putus asa.

programme.title: Kopi & Susu Aja Bisa Bersatu, Aku & Kamu Kapan?
programme.desc: Audi, seorang gadis desa yang merantau ke Jakarta karena mendapat tawaran kerja di gerai kopi dari pamannya. Namun tanpa diduga, seiring berjalannya waktu Audi terlibat cinta segitiga dengan Rangga si anak pemilik, dan Fero karyawan di gerai kopi tersebut.

Saat Della mau membenarkan mobilnya, Zacky malah menertawakannya. Zacky malah nantangin Della kalau berhasil akan ia memberi satu karung pisang nangka. Ternyata Della mampu dan membuat Zacky memberikan satu karung pisang nangka. Della senang karena bisa ia jual namun kakinya langsung lemas manakala gerobak jualannya hilang dicuri. programme.title: Murder Syndicate
programme.desc: Ketika matriark dari sebuah keluarga pembunuh bayaran jatuh sakit, ketiga anaknya dan pacarnya yang lebih muda saling berebut untuk mengambil alih kerajaan bisnisnya.

programme.title: Don't Suck
programme.desc: Kesempatan terakhir seorang komedian veteran untuk menjadi bintang membawanya ke jalan bersama seorang komedian muda yang mengungkap masa lalu yang tak terduga.

programme.title: The Great War
programme.desc: Pada hari-hari terakhir Perang Dunia Pertama, sekelompok tentara AS dikirim ke belakang garis musuh untuk menyelamatkan sebuah peleton yang tersesat.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Clown Motel
Born To Dance
programme.desc: Tu adalah seorang pemuda ambisius yang bermimpi menjadi penari hip-hop profesional. Kala sang ayah melarangnya, ia malah memutuskan untuk menjadikan tarian sebagai jalan hidupnya.

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: Seorang kurir khusus ditugaskan untuk mengirim sebuah kotak misterius ke dunia pembunuh bayaran nan berbahaya.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Seorang perawat asal Inggris lolos dari serangan di pos terdepan. Saat ia diburu oleh kelompok yang dipimpin Jerman, ia memulai perjalanan epik demi menyelamatkan pos terdekat dengan bantuan dari pejuang setempat.

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs
programme.desc: Mengikuti seekor anjing yang merupakan ahli melarikan diri, yang harus bekerja sama dengan teman-teman anak anjingnya untuk mencegah blok mereka dirampok.

programme.title: AfterDeath
programme.desc: Akibat tragedi yang terjadi di klub malam, lima orang korban tewas terbangun di sebuah pantai. Takut dan bingung, mereka mencoba memahami berbagai hal dan bertanya-tanya apakah mereka sungguh sedang berada di neraka.

programme.title: AfterDeath
programme.desc: Akibat tragedi yang terjadi di klub malam, lima orang korban tewas terbangun di sebuah pantai. Takut dan bingung, mereka mencoba memahami berbagai hal dan bertanya-tanya apakah mereka sungguh sedang berada di neraka.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: Di Barat yang tak ada aturan hukum, The Cowboys, kakak-beradik pembunuh dan pencuri nan terkenal, menguasai wilayah tersebut dengan tinju brutal dan senjata api. Namun, takdir akhirnya datang menghampiri mereka.

programme.title: The Curse Of Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Seorang pria mewarisi rumah leluhurnya dan sebuah kutukan kuno yang berasal dari Perang Salib.

programme.title: Exists
programme.desc: Sekelompok teman menjalajahi kawasan hutan terpencil di Texas untuk bersenang-senang di akhir pekan, namun mereka dibuntuti oleh Bigfoot.

programme.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
programme.desc: Film ini mengikuti perjalanan seorang pria yang memburu geng saudaranya di seluruh wilayah barat Amerika untuk menghentikan aksi brutal mereka.

programme.title: The Housekeeper
programme.desc: Seorang pembantu rumah tangga muda menerima posisi menjanjikan di rumah sebuah keluarga kaya, hanya untuk menyadari bahwa seseorang mungkin menyembunyikan rahasia yang mematikan. programme.desc: Musim pertama Hidden Cities Extreme mengikuti Simon Yin menjelajahi berbagai negara di Asia untuk mencoba langsung pengalaman-pengalaman yang menantang sekaligus memperkenalkan kekayaan budaya setempat. Mulai dari mempelajari seni bela diri Eskrima di Filipina, mengikuti balap kerbau di Indonesia, hingga mencicipi makanan khas yang tidak biasa, setiap perjalanan menghadirkan sisi budaya yang autentik dan jarang terlihat oleh wisatawan. Dengan memadukan petualangan, tantangan ekstrem, dan eksplorasi budaya, serial ini mengajak penonton melihat Asia dari sudut pandang yang berbeda.

programme.title: Ghosts S5: Michael Jackson
programme.desc: Trevor mendapat masalah ketika hadiah yang tidak pantas untuk seorang rekan kerja memaksanya menghadiri rapat HR yang hanya bisa ditangani oleh Jay; Pete tanpa sengaja memicu drama dengan Alberta setelah dengan santai menyebutkan kunjungan kejutan kepada mantan kekasihnya.

programme.title: Hotel Costiera: Hassan
programme.desc: Seorang anak laki-laki bernama Hassan mencari Daniel di hotel. Saat Daniel melindunginya, dia menemukan lokasi Alice tetapi tiba terlambat, seseorang telah mendahuluinya.

programme.title: Celebrity Wheel Of... S5, Ep 7
programme.desc: Celebrity Wheel of Fortune menyambut para kontestan selebriti untuk memutar roda paling terkenal di dunia dan memecahkan teka-teki kata untuk kesempatan memenangkan hadiah hingga $1 juta.

programme.title: Survivor S51, Ep 8
programme.desc: Dua puluh satu peserta baru bersaing di Fiji demi gelar Sole Survivor dan hadiah US$1 juta. Dalam era Open Era, berbagai twist, idol, dan keuntungan dari musim sebelumnya dapat muncul kapan saja, menguji strategi dan ketahanan peserta.

programme.title: Entertainment Tonight
programme.desc: Sejak pertama kali diluncurkan, ENTERTAINMENT TONIGHT telah menjadi otoritas terkemuka dalam pemberitaan hiburan terkini. Program ini merupakan majalah berita hiburan terkemuka di dunia yang disiarkan secara nasional.

programme.title: FBI S9: Ultimatum
programme.desc: Bahan yang sangat radioaktif dicuri dari fasilitas pembuangan limbah medis, sehingga tim harus melacak pencurinya. Eva mendapati dirinya berada di tengah situasi yang genting.

programme.title: Tim Penyelamat Tayo
programme.desc: Pergi tim penyelamat! Lindungi kota! Kendaraan penyelamat baru, mobil polisi, dan truk pemadam kebakaran datang untuk menyelamatkan!

programme.title: Howie, Landau'S Adventures In Seabed
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Boboiboy
programme.desc: Seorang anak laki-laki menggunakan teknologi alien yang mengubahnya menjadi pahlawan super, saat ia bertempur melawan alien yang kecanduan biji kakao.

programme.title: Pororo -Season 7
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang petualangan Pororo dan teman-temannya yang tinggal di desa bersalju Porong Porong Forest, yang sering menghadapi tantangan serta mempelajari pelajaran praktis dan moral dalam setiap episode.

programme.title: Tayo Thematic Show Season 2
programme.desc: Kisah Tayo dan teman-temannya dengan berbagai tema! Kami mengundang Anda ke desa keliling tempat bus-bus kecil berkumpul.

programme.title: Pororo'S Healthy Habits
programme.desc: Halo teman-teman? Saya Pororo! Bisakah kita belajar bersama tentang bagaimana tumbuh sebagai anak yang sehat?

programme.title: Oddbods Season 2
programme.desc: Geng Fuse, Newt, Pogo, Bubbles, Jeff, Zee, dan Slick yang unik dan unik tertawa, menipu, dan menjalani hidup mereka.

programme.title: Masha & The Bear
programme.desc: Seekor beruang sirkus pensiunan menetap di hutan dan bersiap untuk kehidupan baru yang tenang dikelilingi oleh kedamaian dan ketenangan sampai dia diperkenalkan dengan seorang gadis kecil petualang bernama Masha. Masha adalah seorang gadis Rusia yang tinggal di hutan bersama babi, kambing, dan anjingnya.

programme.title: Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: Serial Animasi Keluarga yang membahas kehidupan masyarakat sehari-hari melalui tokoh utama, Pak Somat , Bu Inah, Dudung, Ninung dan warga lainnya yang ber-Bhinneka Tunggal Ika.

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul
programme.desc: Bedu dan Adul adalah sebuah serial film animasi 3D tentang petualangan anak-anak di kawasan pinggiran Jakarta.

programme.title: Tayo Season 7
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan hidup bahagia bersama, bus kecil Tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak lagi yang harus dipelajari untuk Tayo. Tayo dan teman-temannya yang ramah, Rogi, Lani, dan Gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

programme.title: Pororo Super Super Show
programme.desc: Eddy, apa penemuan terpentingmu? Shark, kenapa kamu selalu mengganggu teman-temanmu? Loopy, apa yang kamu suka lakukan selain memasak? Dalam acara komedi talk show baru ini, teman-teman Porong Porong mengunjungi studio untuk berbincang dengan MC Pororo dan menjawab semua pertanyaanmu!

programme.title: Pororo'S Thematic Show
programme.desc: Tema cerita Pororo dan kawan-kawan. Anda akan diajak ke desa Porong Porong, sebuah tempat yang penuh dengan petualangan.

programme.title: Arpo The Robot Season 3
programme.desc: Arpo dirancang sebagai robot komando, dibangun sebagai mesin tempur yang ganas. Namun, dengan tercapainya perdamaian dunia, Arpo telah diperlengkapi kembali untuk pengasuhan, diberi kode ulang untuk dipeluk, dan secara resmi dipindahkan sebagai robot pengasuh!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Serial ini menggambarkan bagaimana karakter-karakter ini selamat dari bahaya kehidupan sehari-hari, secara tidak sengaja mengubah situasi biasa menjadi peristiwa yang tidak terduga, luar biasa, dan selalu lucu.

programme.title: Morphle - English Season 7
programme.desc: Ikuti petualangan Mila yang berusia 5 tahun dan hewan peliharaan ajaibnya Morphle, yang dapat berubah menjadi apa pun yang diimpikan Mila!

programme.title: Rainbow Bubblegem
programme.desc: Rainbow Bubblegem

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: Tian Tian
programme.desc: Tian Tian

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: Abang L The Explorer
programme.desc: Abang L The Explorer

programme.title: ABANG L THE EXPLORER
programme.desc: Abang l the explorer sebuah veriety show yang memberikan hiburan dan edukasi. Dimana abang l akan mengajak penonton bermain sekaligus belajar hal-hal seusia abang l dan berbeda disetiap episodenya. Tingkah lucu, gemas dan keaktifan abang l akan menjadi warna yang menghidupi program ini. Abang l yang pinter berbicara akan bertanya kepada orang di sekitar abang l. abang l juga akan mencoba beberapa profesi yang bertujuan untuk mengedukasi dari setiap peran profesi tersebut.

programme.title: Bluey 2

Bersama adiknya, bingo, serta kedua orang tuanya, bandit dan chilli, bluey menjalani berbagai permainan imajinatif yang memicu rasa ingin tahu dan kreativitas.

SEMENTARA MEREKA MENGASAH KEKUATAN TERASTAL, MEREKA JUGA HARUS MENGHADAPI TANTANGAN TURNAMEN DAN SERANGAN MENDADAK DARI MUSUH.

MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. programme.title: Madun
programme.desc: Madun

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.desc: Animasi dan lagu 3d berbahasa indonesia, cocomelon menciptakan dunia yang berpusat pada pengalaman sehari-hari anak kecil. selain membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, warna, dan banyak lagi. video tersebut memberikan pelajaran kehidupan prososial. memberi orang tua kesempatan untuk mengajar dan bermain dengan anak-anak mereka saat mereka menonton bersama.

programme.desc: THE FIXIES ADALAH SERIAL ANIMASI RUSIA YANG MENGIKUTI PETUALANGAN PARA "FIXIES," MAKHLUK KECIL YANG HIDUP DI DALAM PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK. MEREKA MEMPERBAIKI MASALAH TEKNOLOGI SEHARI-HARI SAMBIL MENGAJARKAN PENONTON TENTANG SAINS DAN TEKNOLOGI SECARA MENYENANGKAN. SERIAL INI DIRANCANG UNTUK ANAK-ANAK UNTUK BELAJAR TENTANG PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK DAN PENTINGNYA PERAWATANNYA.

programme.title: Morphle 3D
programme.desc: Morphle 3D

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Ayah Mila mengelola satu-satunya toko hewan peliharaan ajaib di kota ini - tempat yang fantastis di mana Anda bisa menemukan berbagai macam hewan peliharaan yang lucu dan unik, yang masing-masing memiliki kekuatan sihir yang unik, dan dia telah menghadiahkan hewan peliharaan paling ajaib untuk Mila, yaitu Morphle.

programme.title: Wakakibo Kids
programme.desc: Wakakibo Kids

programme.title: WAKAKIBO KIDS
programme.desc: DI DASAR GUNUNG PISANG, TEPAT DI PINGGIRAN HUTAN TROPIS FANTASI YANG DIPENUHI DENGAN BERBAGAI HEWAN LUCU DAN MENGGEMASKAN, TERLETAKLAH DESA TEMPAT TINGGAL DUA SAHABAT KITA: WAKA DAN KIBO. WAKA, SEORANG ANAK YANG GEMAR MAKAN DAN TERLIHAT SEPERTI ANAK YANG LAMBAN, SEBENARNYA SANGAT HATI-HATI DAN SELALU BERPIKIR SEBELUM BERTINDAK. DI SISI LAIN, KIBO, DENGAN RAMBUT KERITING TEBALNYA, ADALAH SOSOK YANG CERIA, SELALU INGIN TAHU, DAN MUDAH BERTEMAN DENGAN SIAPA PUN. BERBEDA DENGAN WAKA, KIBO SERING KALI BERTINDAK TANPA BERPIKIR TERLEBIH DAHULU. KISAH PERSAHABATAN ANTARA WAKA DAN KIBO DI DESA MEREKA YANG PENUH WARNA DAN KEHIDUPAN MEMBAWA KITA PADA PETUALANGAN-PETUALANGAN YANG MENGHIBUR DAN MEMUKAU, DI MANA KEDUA KARAKTER INI BELAJAR DARI PERBEDAAN MEREKA DAN SALING MELENGKAPI SATU SAMA LAIN.

programme.title: Titipo Titipo
programme.desc: Titipo Titipo

programme.title: TITIPO TITIPO
programme.desc: KERETA LITTLE TITIPO YANG BARU LAHIR DI KOTA CHOO CHOO BARU SAJA LULUS UJIAN MENGEMUDI DAN SIAP BEKERJA DI DESA KERETA API. MESKIPUN TITIPO BERMIMPI MENJADI KERETA TERBAIK DI DUNIA, KEPRIBADIANNYA YANG PENASARAN MEMBUATNYA SELALU BERADA DI DALAM PERISTIWA DAN MASALAH YANG TIDAK TERDUGA SETIAP HARI. TITIPO MEMPERLUAS PENGALAMANNYA DI DUNIA YANG LEBIH BESAR DAN BERTEMAN DENGAN GENIE, DIESEL, DAN KERETA KECIL LAINNYA. AKANKAH TITIPO MENCAPAI MIMPINYA MENJADI KERETA TERBAIK? BERGABUNGLAH DENGAN PERJALANAN KERETA API DAN TEMUI TITIPO DAN TEMAN -TEMAN KERETA KECIL.

programme.title: Katuri
programme.desc: Katuri

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri adalah sebuah acara menarik tentang empat anak burung pegar yang tumbuh di hutan alami di bawah perawatan dan kasih sayang lembut ibu flora. Ibu flora selalu mendorong anak-anaknya untuk menjelajahi dunia bersama hewan lain dan membantu mereka kapan pun mereka membutuhkan. Ketika anak-anak burung merak mengalami kesulitan atau bahkan bahaya, ibu flora selalu ada untuk menjaga mereka tetap aman.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo si penguin kecil dan teman -temannya tinggal di tanah yang damai yang ditutupi salju dan es. programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. programme.title: JAD ET SES SOEURS
programme.desc: Jad et ses soeurs mengisahkan kehidupan sehari-hari Jad bersama dua saudara kembarnya, Ranya dan Syrine. Dalam setiap episode, mereka menghadapi berbagai situasi yang dekat dengan dunia anak-anak, mulai dari kegiatan sekolah, permainan bersama teman, perjalanan keluarga, hingga tantangan kecil yang mengajarkan nilai-nilai kehidupan. Dengan latar budaya Maroko yang kental, serial animasi ini memperkenalkan tradisi, kebiasaan, dan keramahan masyarakat setempat. Dikemas dengan humor dan cerita yang hangat, serial ini mengajarkan pentingnya kerja sama, rasa hormat, tanggung jawab, serta kasih sayang dalam keluarga.

programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI
programme.desc: Compostman et Moi adalah dokumenter yang mengisahkan perjalanan Florian Bonnet, seorang aktivis lingkungan yang dikenal dengan julukan "Compostman". Dengan semangat mengurangi limbah makanan dan meningkatkan kesadaran akan pentingnya pengelolaan sampah organik, ia berkeliling menemui berbagai komunitas untuk memperkenalkan manfaat pengomposan. Melalui kisah-kisah inspiratif, inisiatif masyarakat, dan penjelasan mengenai dampak positif pengomposan terhadap lingkungan, dokumenter ini menunjukkan bagaimana tindakan sederhana sehari-hari dapat membantu mengurangi sampah, memperbaiki kualitas tanah, dan mendukung gaya hidup yang lebih ramah lingkungan.

programme.title: Veteran

programme.title: Love 911
programme.desc: Ketika seorang dokter dituntut karena salah mendiagnosis pasien, dia menghubungi petugas pemadam kebakaran yang berdedikasi untuk menjadi saksi karakternya. Kisah cinta yang tidak terduga muncul di antara mereka berdua.

programme.title: Cafe Midnight
programme.desc: Yoon pergi mencari pengantin prianya, Taeyoung, yang tidak muncul di hari pernikahan. Secara kebetulan, ia tiba di sebuah tempat aneh bernama 'Cafe Midnight' dan menemukan Taeyoung yang berusia muda dari masa lalu.

programme.title: The Childe
programme.desc: Marco, seorang petinju yang lahir dari ayah Korea dan ibu Filipina. Akibat kesulitan keuangan dan ibu yang sakit-sakitan, Marco memutuskan pergi ke Korea Selatan untuk mencari keberadaan sang ayah yang sejak kecil meninggalkannya. Setibanya di Korea Selatan, Marco mendadak menjadi buronan seorang pria misterius dan sekelompok orang jahat yang tak pernah berhenti mengejarnya.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.

programme.title: The King's Warden
programme.desc: Berlatar belakang Dinasti Joseon, dan konon mengisahkan tentang raja keenam Joseon, Danjong, yang diasingkan ke Yeongwol, Provinsi Gangwon.

programme.title: The Noisy Mansion (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Geo-Wool pindah setelah bertengkar dengan saudara laki-lakinya, Du-On. Di apartemen barunya di Baekse, dia mendengar suara-suara misterius di lantai pada pukul 4 pagi. Karena tidak bisa tidur, dia dan tetangganya menyelidiki sumber suara tersebut.

programme.title: War Of The Arrows (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Berlatar saat invasi Manchu ke-dua di Korea, Nam Yi, yang merupakan seorang pemanah terbaik di Korea, melawan Dinasti Qing untuk menyelamatkan adik perempuannya, Ja In, yang akan diperbudak oleh penduduk Manchuria.

programme.title: Confession (TVN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang pria yang menjadi tersangka kasus pembunuhan mencari bantuan dari seorang pengacara untuk membuktikan bahwa ia tidak bersalah. Saat mereka mulai mengumpulkan bukti-bukti, kebenaran pun perlahan terkuak.

programme.title: Dillinger And Capone [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.desc: When a young scientist learns she has unwittingly aided a destructive plan against the Indian farmers she was supposedly sent to help, she teams up with a local farmer to save the day.

programme.title: Until Death
programme.desc: Anthony Stowe (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is a drug-addicted detective teetering on the edge. He shows little regard for his fellow cops, ratting out a respected veteran who takes him to task shortly before he's fired. All Stowe cares about is putting away drug-dealing former cop Callahan (Stephen Rea), who is taking over New Orleans' underworld. But Callahan's henchman (Stephen Lord) puts Stowe in a coma, and after he awakens, he realizes it's more important to redeem himself and get off drugs.

programme.title: Plan 9 From Outer Space
programme.desc: Residents of California's San Fernando Valley are under attack by flying saucers from outer space. The aliens, led by Eros (Dudley Manlove) and his assistant, Tanna (Joanna Lee), intend to conquer the planet by resurrecting corpses in a Hollywood cemetery. The living dead -- a cape-wearing ghoul (Bela Lugosi), a vampire (Vampira) and a slow-footed cop (Tor Johnson) who was killed for his nosiness -- stalk curious humans who wander into the cemetery looking for evidence of the UFOs.

programme.title: Triple 9
programme.desc: Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. Unhappy with the results, ruthless gangster Irina Vlaslov orders the men to pull off another job. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.

programme.title: Rough Magic
programme.desc: In the midst of a dazzling stage show, magician's assistant Myra Shumway (Bridget Fonda) catches the eye of sleazy industrialist Cliff Wyatt (D.W. Moffett). When Wyatt unwittingly kills Shumway's mentor, a master magician, she flees to Mexico. Furious, Wyatt hires private detective Alex Ross (Russell Crowe) to capture the gorgeous witness to his crime. But, after Ross locates Shumway, he finds himself beguiled by her growing prowess as a magician -- and by the potency of her feminine charms.

programme.title: Bloodfist
programme.desc: A Los Angeles kickboxer (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) trains with a master (Joe Marie Avellana) in Manila to avenge his brother in a tournament.

programme.title: Holy Motors
programme.desc: Driven around Paris by a loyal driver (Edith Scob), a mysterious man (Denis Lavant) dresses up in costumes and plays a number of strange, semiscripted roles.

programme.title: The Big Sleep
programme.desc: Philip Marlowe (Robert Mitchum), private eye, in the 1970s London.

programme.title: Rendel: Dark Vengeance
programme.desc: Rendel, a masked superhero, becomes blinded by his desire for revenge against a sinister criminal organization.

programme.title: Red Riding: 1974
programme.desc: When a young girl goes missing, Yorkshire Post crime reporter Eddie Dunford (Andrew Garfield) becomes intrigued by a series of mysterious child murders that date back several years and mirror to the current case. He faces stiff opposition from the local police and his editor, Bill (John Henshaw). Eddie's troubles escalate when he becomes involved with a moody widow (Rebecca Hall) who has a mysterious connection to wealthy developer John Dawson (Sean Bean).

programme.title: Hopscotch
programme.desc: When CIA operative Miles Kendig (Walter Matthau) deliberately lets KGB agent Yaskov (Herbert Lom) get away, his boss (Ned Beatty) threatens to retire him. Kendig beats him to it, however, destroying his own records and traveling to Austria where he begins work on a memoir that will expose all his former agency's covert practices. The CIA catches wind of the book and sends other agents after him, initiating a frenetic game of cat and mouse that spans the globe.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: When Helen, a London ad executive, is fired from her job and rushes out to catch a train, two scenarios take place. In one, she gets on the train and comes home to find her boyfriend, Gerry, in bed with another woman. In the second, she misses the train and arrives after the woman has left. Following the first scenario, Helen dumps Gerry, finds a new man and gradually improves her life. Under the second scenario, she becomes suspicious of Gerry's fidelity and grows miserable.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.desc: Accused of murder, a martial artist goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origins and the unknown enemies out to destroy him.

programme.desc: Bong is a highly respected cop with a long history of success on dangerous cases. However, his past soon comes back to haunt him when his former protégé seeks revenge against all those who have wronged him.

programme.desc: A former arm-wrestling champion raised in the U.S. returns to South Korea for a tournament that could return him to glory, but he finds his life complicated by the appearance of the biological family he never knew.

programme.title: Day Zero
programme.desc: A former elite soldier is released from jail only to discover that the outside world has been taken over by a dangerous virus. Chased by hordes of the undead, he fights tooth and nail in a desperate attempt to reach his estranged family.

programme.title: Crazy Samurai: 400 vs. 1
programme.desc: A master samurai, Musashi Miyamoto, battles 400 swordsmen as they challenge his place as the samurai of the century.

programme.title: Paradox
programme.desc: A tough Hong Kong cop's teenage daughter disappears in Pattaya. He goes to Thailand to find her and must deal with corrupt cops, but an honest one helps him track down culprits involved in illegal organ trafficking.

programme.title: Legend of Gatotkaca
programme.desc: Legends collide as young Yuda wrestles to unlock newfound god-like powers, defending his world in an endless battle against ancient and powerful evils.

programme.title: The Flying Swordsman
programme.desc: After two heroes are killed during an outside attempt to steal a hidden fortune, the treasure map inexplicably disappears -- until a decade later when the original eight assassins reemerge only to be challenged by a mysterious swordsman.

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: A low-level drug dealer joins forces with an ambitious cop to bring down a psychotic cartel kingpin.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: The Sentinel

programme.title: Dark Minds

programme.title: Strange But True

programme.desc: An inspiring look at JK Rowling's rise to become one of the most influential writers-from her humble beginnings, as an imaginative young girl and awkward teenager, to the loss of her mother and the genesis of the Harry Potter phenomenon.

programme.title: Mr. Magorium's Wonder Emporium

programme.title: Arthur: All About D.W./Blockheads

programme.sub-title: Background Blues/And Now Let's Talk To Some Kids

programme.sub-title: Buster's Book Battle/On the Buster Scale

programme.title: Arthur: Love Notes For Muffy/D.W. Blows The Whistle
programme.desc: When Muffy tries to bribe the judges at the school science fair, Francine and The Brain plot revenge. And D.W., a newly-deputized Junior Safety Officer, has a reputation for being a strict enforcer of the rules--well, OK, a tattle-tale.
programme.sub-title: Love Notes For Muffy/D.W. Blows The Whistle

programme.sub-title: Prunella the Packrat/What's in a Name?

programme.title: Arthur: The World of Tomorrow/Is There a Doctor in the House?

programme.sub-title: The World of Tomorrow/Is There a Doctor in the House?

programme.desc: Is The Brain a snob? That seems to be the explanation for why he won't go to Waterworld with his friends. And, Arthur's a notorious joke-killer. But when he's scheduled to perform as a carnival clown, he learns how to make people laugh!
programme.sub-title: Water and The Brain/Arthur The Unfunny

programme.title: Arthur: D.W.'s Name Game/Finders Key-Pers
programme.desc: D.W. and Arthur get their feelings hurt when their efforts to insult each other get out of control. Next, Arthur, Brain, and Binky find a key--but to what? And which of them will get to keep whatever fabulous thing they find with it?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Leonardo Versus Tempestra

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Michelangelo Meets Mondo Gecko

programme.desc: "Hola, hola!/ Hello, Hello!/ It's a great day for school/ You know!" Boots' music teacher, la maestra de música, needs to get to school in a hurry - but her bicycle is broken!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: On a nightly training run, the Turtles and Casey Jones break up a Purple Dragon robbery. One of the perps is Angel, a girl Casey knows from the neighborhood who's going through her initiation rites to become a Purple Dragon.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The boys have made friends with a group of homeless, and are worried when they start mysteriously disappearing into the night! Some Turtle-style detective work leads them to the Garbageman.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Oroku Saki (aka the Shredder) attempts to convince Leonardo that Saki is fighting the good fight … that he's out there carrying on the great tradition of Bushido and Ninjitsu, and the turtles should stand with him.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Unconvincing Turtle Titan: Believing the Turtles can accomplish so much more for the city, and inspired by iconic superhero Silver Sentry, Michelangelo decides to take a crack at being a superhero.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Notes From The Underground Part 1: When Don's examination of some mysterious crystals attracts the attention of a subterranean monster, the Turtles underground exploration unearths a Foot Genetics Lab!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Notes From The Underground Part 2: After discovering an abandoned underground Foot Genetics Lab, and being attacked by once-human Digging Creatures, the Turtles assist those very creatures in trying to repair a Force Field.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Notes From The Underground Part 3: After befriending the once-human creatures in an abandoned underground Foot Genetics Lab, the Turtles join them on a journey deeper into the earth, where they come upon the ruins of a once-great subterranean city.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The King: With all the turtles living in April's apartment, things are getting a little crazy. But, when Donatello stumbles upon a fantastic monster in the basement, things get crazier.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Shredder Strikes Back - Part 1: On a training run Leo is ambushed by a major Foot attack force, including Foot Tech Ninjas, their old enemy Hun, and a new threat: the Foot Elite!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Shredder Strikes Back - Part 2: When the Foot Ninja attack April's apartment in force, the Turtles fight against overwhelming odds to get the wounded Leo to safety.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Tales of Leo: The Turtles, Splinter, Casey and April just barely manage to escape from the explosion that destroys the antique store. They hit the road and hide out at Casey's grandmother's old farmhouse, but Leonardo is badly wounded.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Monster Hunter: Still recuperating up at Casey's grandmother's farm, the turtles are feeling the sting of boredom. Luckily, a scientist known as the "Monster Hunter" has come to the area searching for a legendary monster…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to New York - Part 1: The Turtles return to New York (as the title might suggest) with one goal in mind: to destroy the Shredder once and for all.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to New York - Part 2: The Turtles and Splinter continue to fight their way up through the Foot Headquarters skyscraper, facing down three misshapen Mutant Shredder Clones, a hallway of traps, and the Mystic Ninja.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to New York - Part 3: With Stockman showing up in the middle of the final battle between our heroes and the Shredder, everything is thrown into chaos … so much so that our heroes must join forces with the Shredder and Hun to defeat Stockman.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Lone Raph & Cub: With Splinter mysteriously vanished last episode, the Turtles are feeling frustrated, not knowing where to start looking for him. Impatient with strategizing, Raph heads off on his own, and runs into a solo adventure.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Search for Splinter Part 1: After the frustrated Turtles exhaust their search for Splinter, their suspicions turn to the Guardians, and the trail soon leads them to a non-descript building, the initials of its company name spelling out "TCRI."

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Search for Splinter Part 2: The Turtles successfully infiltrate the mysterious TCRI Building, where they manage to sneak into its inner sanctum, and locate the unconscious Splinter inside a stasis tank.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 1 The Fugitoid: Our four heroes find themselves beamed halfway across the universe to the planet D'Hoonnib and right into the middle of a police action! There, they befriend the Fugitoid, a.k.a. Professor Honeycutt.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 1 The Fugitoid

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 2 The Trouble with Triceratons: On the planet D'Hoonnib, the Turtles team up with the Fugitoid, a.k.a. Professor Honeycutt, who is being pursued by the rogue military forces of General Blanque.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 2 The Trouble with Triceratons

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 3 The Big House: The Turtles are captured by the Triceratons and thrown into a Tri prison, their lives to be used as a bargaining chip to convince the Fugitoid to build his Teleportal device.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 3 The Big House

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 4 The Arena: Welcome to the Tri-sports Arena filled to capacity with cheering Triceraton crowds thirsty to watch grueling combat. Our four heroes have been sentenced to become gladiators in ruthless competition.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 4 The Arena

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 5 Triceraton Wars: With Professor Honeycutt (the Fugitoid) safely in tow and the Prime Leader as a hostage, the turtles are faced with their biggest challenge yet!
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 5 Triceraton Wars

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 1: Back from their adventures in space, the Turtles find themselves in the headquarters of the same aliens who teleported them across the universe! The discovery of an old friend and new allies leads to a trip back through time.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 2: The turtles and Splinter have taken a little trip down the Utroms' memory lane via a high-tech virtual reality device experiencing first hand the Utroms' crash landing on Earth and their life in feudal Japan.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 3: The Turtles and Splinter escape the Utroms' high-tech virtual reality device, only to find the Shredder and all his forces waiting for them. All shell breaks loose in yet another final showdown between our heroes and the Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Reflections: Catching up on some much-needed rest, our heroes take a little trip to Casey's grandma's farmhouse as well as a little trip down memory lane. But, every memory is haunted by the same dark figure … the Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Ultimate Ninja: There's a bad dude in town, and he's looking to pick a fight with Leonardo. This Ultimate Ninja has come halfway across the inter-dimensional universe to fight the Shredder, defeat him and gain glory.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Modern Love - The Return of Nano: The Turtles are in big trouble from a microscopic enemy when the bizarre Nano-monster returns! When the self-replicating techno-nightmare springs his criminal "father" out of jail and goes on another rampage.
programme.sub-title: Modern Love - The Return of Nano

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: What a Croc!: The Turtles discover that they're not alone in the sewer. The green ooze which mutated them years ago also claimed another victim… Leather Head!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to the Underground: The Turtles return to the ancient underground city they discovered in "Notes From the Underground" -- only to find the city abandoned, its crystal moon power source missing, and its human population reverted to monsters.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City at War - Part 1: With the Shredder gone, underworld factions clash for power in a gang war that threatens to tear the city apart!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City at War - Part 2: The Turtles find themselves in the middle of an escalating gang war between the remains of the Foot, the Purple Dragons and the mob (with their new ally Baxter Stockman!) Can the Turtles survive the deadly onslaught?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City at War - Part 3: The turtles have their hands full fighting the mob, the Purple Dragons and what's left of the Foot. Now, they've joined forces with Karai, who used to be the Shredder's right hand "man." Can they trust her?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Team Rocket’s latest invention is bound to be a hit...until Togepi and its newfound Sentret friend take it out for a spin!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Ash hears of a training ground for wild Charizard and decides it's just the place to hone his own Charizard’s strength. But the tough lessons to be learned there will change Ash and Charizard’s friendship forever!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Back on the road to the Azalea Gym, our heroes discover a Sunflora festival in a nearby town and meet a Trainer whose Sunflora is too sad to compete. Can Ash and the gang put a smile on its face?

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Ash is having a hard time getting his Chikorita to listen to him, and Nurse Joy thinks that it’s due to a bout of jealousy over Ash’s friendship with Pikachu! Can Ash prove how much Chikorita means to him?

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: Our heroes meet a Trainer whose Hoppip partners can predict the weather. But on the horizon, there are two storms approaching...and one of them goes by the name 'Team Rocket'!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: When an unruly herd of Mareep ruin their lunch plans, our heroes decide to help their timid herder in time to compete in a local battle festival.

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys
programme.desc: When the top student at a Pokémon training center loses interest in Pokémon battles, opting to build a comprehensive Pokémon database instead, it’s up to Ash to convince him that battling is not just about probability!

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: Pokemon: The Johto Journeys

programme.title: The Berry Big Harvest
programme.desc: Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables his garden has never grown so much produce! Soon Orange's store is overflowing with Berry Bitty Fruits & Veggies. It's the berry first time Orange has not been able to find a “place for everything” in her store.

programme.title: Blippi The Musical

Your Blippi fan will enjoy learning about the world while singing and dancing along with this special show. There's so much to explore—it'll make you want to sing and shout!

programme.title: Room at the Top
programme.desc: Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom. Grateful for the support and not wanting to dampen anyone's enthusiasm, Strawberry tells each of them yes (actually, more like not-no).

programme.title: Starlight, Star Bright
programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine! The girls and Berrykins rush to turn the Marketplace Café into a suitable performance area for a big star like Cherry Jam.
